name: mwangaben/laravel-nats-server
description: NATS broadcaster for Laravel with Laravel Echo compatibility

scripts.test-nats: nats server run & sleep 3 && vendor/bin/phpunit && pkill -f 'nats server'
scripts.nats-server-restart: pkill -f 'nats server' && sleep 2 && nats server run
scripts.test-connection: php -r "require 'vendor/autoload.php'; \$config = ['host'=>'localhost','port'=>53969,'user'=>'local','pass'=>'4elDZZTb7ofiN83BKjXOvhZvOuhUouhH','debug'=>true]; \$client = new \Mwangaben\Nats\Client(new \Mwangaben\Nats\ConnectionOptions(\$config)); \$client->connect(); echo '✅ Connected to NATS server on port 53969\n';"

suggest.ext-rdkafka: For Kafka support with NATS JetStream
